```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

folder <- "C:/Code Projects/Code Blue Training Year 2/Data/"  
file <- "arcbt.xlsx"
survey_responses <- read_excel(paste0(folder, file))

survey_responses <- survey_responses %>%
  mutate(
    change_con_code = post_con_code - pre_con_code,
    change_con_rapid = post_con_rapid - pre_con_rapid, 
    change_con_rhythm = post_con_rhythm - pre_con_rhthm,
    change_attending = post_attending - pre_attending,
    change_team = post_team - pre_team
  )

summary(survey_responses)

```

```{r}
library(tinytable)
tt(survey_responses)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
```

Pre

```{r}
library(modelsummary)

# Define custom functions for the 25th and 75th percentiles
q1 <- function(x) quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
q3 <- function(x) quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
n_non_missing <- function(x) sum(!is.na(x))

# Create the summary table with median, Q1, Q3, and N
datasummary((N = n_non_missing) +
            (Median = median) + 
            (Q1 = q1) + 
            (Q3 = q3) ~ 
              pre_con_code + pre_con_rapid + pre_con_rhthm + pre_team + pre_attending + pre_lead + pre_codes + pre_rapid + pre_shock + pre_sim, 
            data = survey_responses)
```

Post

```{r}
datasummary((N = n_non_missing) +
            (Median = median) + 
            (Q1 = q1) + 
            (Q3 = q3) ~ 
              post_con_code + post_con_rapid + post_con_rhythm + post_team + post_attending + post_cases + post_modules + post_discuss, 
            data = survey_responses)
```

Change in Scores

```{r}
datasummary((N = n_non_missing) +
            (Median = median) + 
            (Q1 = q1) + 
            (Q3 = q3) ~ 
              change_con_code + change_con_rapid + change_con_rhythm + change_attending + change_team, 
            data = survey_responses)
```

```{r}
datasummary_skim(survey_responses)
```

```{r}
ggstatsplot::ggscatterstats(data = survey_responses, x = pre_con_rhthm, y = change_con_rhythm)

t.test(survey_responses$post_con_rhythm, survey_responses$pre_con_rhthm, paired = TRUE)
?t.test
```

```{r}
ggstatsplot::ggscatterstats(data = survey_responses, x = pre_team, y = change_team)

t.test(survey_responses$post_team, survey_responses$pre_team, paired = TRUE)
?t.test
```
